currentUserGoal: Mobile users report that the game runs poorly; run a mobile-focused optimization session while keeping PC performance healthy.

workCompleted.summary: Profiled the 1200-tile perf harness at phone, large-phone, tablet, and desktop viewport sizes before changing hot paths.
Changed large-field initial zoom for phones and narrow/tablet layouts from 10 target visible tiles to 8, reducing the initial visible live tile count on mobile.
Made per-tile text labels optional on compact/narrow viewports. Desktop still creates labels for hover, while phones/tablets avoid one hidden Phaser Text object per visible tile.
Added stable x/y anchors to TileView so label-less mobile tile views still use correct effect and tween coordinates.

knownIssuesOrDesignQuestions: The in-app browser automation repeatedly timed out after a hot reload, so final browser perf checks were run through a temporary headless Chrome DevTools Protocol harness instead.
Phones and tablets no longer create per-tile hover text labels on compact/narrow viewports. Tile info still uses the existing tile info panel; desktop hover labels remain intact.
Actual physical mobile hardware should still be tested after deploy, especially older Android devices and Safari/iOS.
recommendedNextSteps: Deploy or preview on a real phone and compare the felt panning/tapping smoothness against the pre-optimization build.
If mobile still feels heavy, next profile target should be mobile UI refresh/text setting and weather/automation visual budgets, not board layout.
Consider adding a checked-in CDP perf script if repeated exact mobile viewport harness runs are useful.
doNotRevert: Do not restore the old phone/tablet large-field target of 10 visible tiles without re-profiling; it raised mobile visible tile and display object counts substantially.
Keep compact/narrow tile labels optional unless replacing them with a cheaper mobile-specific hover/info affordance.
Keep TileView x/y anchors as the stable source for tile effect coordinates; base sprites can be tweened and should not be used as persistent anchors.
